description: Estimate monthly revenue for an app, based on install counts, ratings, and category benchmarks. Returns the dollar estimate, a confidence grade (high/medium/low) with the factors behind it, and the methodology used. The figure is a model estimate, not reported revenue; the confidence grade is the part that says how far to trust it. Needs a Sonar API key or connected account (1 credit per call on prepaid API credits); not part of the free tier.

country.description: Market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "mt"). Any App Store storefront (175 countries) or Google Play market (145). Default "us".

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: bundle ID or numeric track ID — the `storeId` returned by sonar_app_search works as-is. Android: package name.

name: sonar_app_revenue
title: Estimate App Revenue
